items.title: Proposal for a COUNCIL DIRECTIVE amending Directives 2003/49/EC, 2009/133/EC, 2011/96/EU, (EU) 2016/1164, (EU)2017/1852, (EU) 2025/50 as regards the simplification of the Union framework on direct taxation and supporting growth and competitiveness of the EU
items.summary: This proposal aims to simplify the EU direct taxation framework to support growth and competitiveness. It amends multiple existing directives to streamline tax compliance and reduce administrative burdens for businesses operating across EU borders.
items.financeImpact: Potential reduction in cross-border tax compliance costs and administrative overhead, improving cash flow predictability for EU-based operations.
items.action: Monitor legislative progress and assess potential compliance cost savings for cross-border B2B operations.

items.title: Proposal for a COUNCIL DIRECTIVE on administrative cooperation in the field of taxation (recast)
items.summary: A proposal to recast the directive on administrative cooperation in taxation, aiming to strengthen information exchange and transparency among EU member states to prevent tax evasion and improve tax administration efficiency.
items.financeImpact: May increase reporting transparency requirements and administrative overhead related to cross-border financial data sharing.
items.action: Review internal tax reporting workflows to ensure readiness for enhanced EU-wide information exchange standards.

items.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL establishing a framework of measures for strengthening Europe’s cloud and AI ecosystem (Cloud and AI Development Act)
items.summary: This proposed regulation establishes a framework to strengthen Europe's cloud and AI ecosystem. It aims to boost regional development, infrastructure, and adoption of AI and cloud technologies across the Union.
items.financeImpact: May provide funding opportunities, subsidies, or infrastructure support, while potentially introducing new compliance standards for AI SaaS providers.
items.action: Track funding opportunities and align product roadmap with emerging EU cloud and AI standards.
